scope: Refresh open-source DWG/DXF/3D route capability and release boundaries, then refine the existing optional comparator checkpoint without expanding per-slice work or promoting support claims.

method.kind: Primary-source release/documentation review and local plan reconciliation
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing GDAL, ACadSharp, LibreDWG, ACadRust/OpenCADStudio, and cq-acis route rows and composed gates
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: latest implementation and research status; findings/subplans and deferred external J items
method.limitations: Capability statements and release pages are not runtime conformance results. Mutable documentation and pre-releases are not substituted for exact released artifacts. No external peer output, sample, geometry kernel, or native CAD result was produced in this review.

evidence.topic: GDAL Binary DXF, raw ASM, and direct-transcode route separation
evidence.observed: GDAL documents Binary DXF reading starting with 3.12 and a distinct no-extra-parameter binary-to-ASCII direct conversion. Its OGR reader supports opt-in raw group values; modern 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY/SURFACE entities are skipped by default and AC1027+ 3D-extensible mode exposes raw ASM bytes plus a 12-value transform rather than an OGR solid. Autodesk's binary-DXF reference defines typed little-endian values, including IEEE doubles, so ASCII spelling is not a byte-equivalent oracle.
doesNotEstablish: GDAL direct binary-to-ASCII conversion is a semantic OGR reader pass
the direct conversion path exercises 3D-extensible mode, block ownership, or ASM transformation
OGR feature projection is complete document/object-graph preservation
raw ASM extraction is ACIS parsing, B-rep validity, or downstream CAD acceptance
evidence.planUse: At the existing composed checkpoint only, keep Binary-DXF parsing, raw-ASM/transform extraction, and direct transcode as separate outcomes. Use the direct path only for generated wire-value inspection; use the pinned reader/API and explicit options for source handle/type, raw group, carrier, owner, and transform checks. Compare decoded values to an independent authored manifest.

evidence.observed: ACadSharp's latest formal release remains signed v3.8.0 at 3a1c66b and does not announce ACIS DXF writing; PR #1240 remains separate open work. LibreDWG's newest visible release entry is prerelease 0.14.8612, not a new stable release. ACadRust v0.6.4 and OpenCADStudio v2026.41 remain one codec lineage plus an application route. cq-acis 0.3.12 is attested to source commit e05a8f470d2f6799277f7b7df467d2fc35625889, but parses inner SAT/SAB rather than outer DWG/DXF/AcDs and constructs shapes through the OCCT-family kernel.
doesNotEstablish: current runtime behavior for any unexecuted peer release or nightly
ACadSharp ACIS writer behavior from an open pull request
independent evidence from wrappers or applications using the same codec lineage
an independent kernel result from cq-acis/OCCT-based conversion
outer entity-to-AcDs-to-payload closure from a bare SAT/SAB parse
evidence.planUse: Keep peer outcomes keyed by exact release/commit, platform, operation, version, and route. Count parser, writer, payload decoder, kernel, wrapper, and application separately; do not add a new peer dependency or per-slice run.
